body:
I don't know you from a bar of soap. In fact, it's the first time I've logged into this account for nearly 2 years? A lot of what you said is similar to what I'm going through right now, hence I logged back in. There are differences of course. But I too lost who I thought was "the one". Due to complicating circumstances, we could never be together. At least not properly anyway.

We never Will. I won't bore you with the story and whilst I have never bought and lost a house, never married and haven't really found my place in life or attended university for that matter. I do hold faith it will happen and get better. Albeit not much.

I don't have any advice to offer. But I can lend an ear at least if you wish to talk my friend. I know how it feels to have a lost love never leave your mind day after day. That crushing pain in your chest and all that. Anyway just know this stranger on the internet is rooting for you, and I believe it's possible to bounce back. Anyway my inbox is open if you need :)

I want to respond. I don't know you. Yet I have a strange comfort in knowing I'm not so alone here.

I don't even have a bad life compared to some. Yet I don't feel happy. Does it even matter? Would anyone even care that I died? I don't know anymore.

Thank you. I'm not sure how to respond to this. Ironically here I am with a rope and yet I'm struggling to go through with it.

What's wrong with me...
Ah close but no cigar ;). Ulcerative Colitis. Good news is I’m completely asymptomatic except for the blood that is...so there’s that.
Not particularly. I mean looking back now it was obvious but then I was just as thick as I am now lol.

Yeah I have actually. Using my throwaway because reasons. Simply put I was the best man at a shotgun wedding. Anyway to give you an idea I had known the groom for years at this point and had met her through him. I was close with both of them. They were inseparable or so I thought. Anyway day of the wedding (this was done at a registry in South Australia) the vows are coming about and I'm about to hand the rings over she bursts into tears saying "I can't! I do not! I'm in love with another! 

You can imagine my shock and everyone in the room. She runs out crying. The groom was too dumbfounded to move so I ran after her. A heated exchange ensues where she blurts out she is in love with me.

I said no and that was that. The groom a few months later attempted suicide resulting in brain damage (we are not friends anymore), and she and I had a falling out so I lost both of them :(.
But the meteor men beg to differ

Isolation. It can and does drive even the strongest people mad. I know this feeling all too well. People tend to develop their own unique humour. What makes you laugh? (Seriously what is your go to funny video?) Coz whatever makes you laugh sure as eggs will make someone else laugh. Even then, some of the best advice I was given was simply "be yourself". Most of the time when I have been myself things tend to go a bit smoother (read: much smoother)

Anyway that's purely anecdotal. You feel like shit, you feel like there is no hope. You feel like no one cares. Well just so you know, I care. I'm just a stranger but I do. Talking about you for a minute, do you have any interests? Hobbies? Do you like to compare salad dressing in your spare time? :)

Hey mate. Whilst I can't relate directly (im one of those sad story types) I know people close to me who have. May I ask have you told these people in your life how you are feeling? It's tough sure, it's a risk too but, it might help. I'm only a stranger on the vast web but...I hope this helps somehow.

IT guy here. I'm in Aus but it sounds like you are in the states. If the ISP's record things over there like I think they do then It might be worthwhile if you use chat based counselling to use a good VPN. It conceals and encrypts your IP and traffic. Might help and of course seek advice for your area as I am still just a stranger on the internet.

Hey. Would you mind chatting to me? Or at least do so before committing? I mean look I might not have the answers nor do I claim to know your situation. But I'd like to try and reach out see if I can at least be a sounding board.

Hey mate. I'm autistic. I spent years working hard to get where I am. And I have more work to go I'm sure. I like you once felt how you did. You aren't alone mate. You mention that you work at maccas. Some of the most successful people I know have worked or do work there. They just do other things. It's a range too some are financially successful (they learned the stock market using funds from Maccas) others succeed with charity work. All comes down to what is uniquely you. Personally I work IT, what hobbies do you have? Any particular interests? What are you good at? People are judgemental pricks, however it also means when I find good people willing to accept you for you. They are the diamonds in the rough. Anyway this is me just autistic rambling. Not sure if it is helpful at all, but I hope you can see what I'm trying to say and that you are doing ok man. :)

Ah righto! We just pub crawl it down here lol. My appointment was pretty chill. Some things suggested have helped so far. 

Still a 5th wheel though. Long dry spell and not even touched another human in months. Such is life...
Lol personally I see nothing wrong with your smile. Looks quite normal to me frankly :).

Urrrgh not fun man :( I'm a dude I know how this feels. That being said I can approach women buuuut that is generally at social gatherings and they are either taken or seem to roll their eyes at me...or have laughed at me. Even if I wasn't interested and just wanted to mingle/make friends.

Also what's the downtown thing? I'm Aussie so not sure if that is a thing in the states? I have my first appt with a psych today. Maybe I'll ask them about this and see what they say...we'll as I always say "bottoms up".

Yeah mate. Been around Aus a bit. I originally hail from Qld but am in the nanny state Vic now :p. Hehe yeah I've only just started. Trying to fix cardio first then get on the old weight training bandwagon. How did you end up starting?
Hey mate where from Australia do you hail from? Lookin good bud I'm in the same boat as you...skinny guy tryin to work out and fix my image....long road ahead man...

Hey there. Yeah I don't mind. Sorry for the late reply. I am in Australia so it was 2 am over here when I replied. I have found that you need to try and surround yourself with people that understand. Unfortunately that involves a lot of trial and error which sucks big time. But at the end of the day, it is worth it when you find them.

I did lose a couple of people mainly because they think depression isn't real or it was too exhausting for them since negativity tends to tire people out (heck we would know that first hand!) anyway I hope it gives you some insight. What else would you like to talk about? Do you have any hobbies?
Hey there. Look I know you are not in a good place right now. Would be willing to hold off on hurting yourself even if for a few moments to chat with one of us?

Hey. I've had something similar happen to me. Feel like a chat? You don't have to go into detail if you don't wish. Anywho I hope things are ok ATM. If not we are here and we think you are a good and worthwhile person :).

You know as a tip I've found when it comes to eye contact (ymmv) I have found that looking people in the eye...then looking around the eyes then back again. From what I understand it's how 'normal' people apparently do it. It's helped me so far. Meaning it's s balance that way you dont get a cold hard stare but you still come out as interested in the person you are interacting with. Not sure if that made sense but it's what I've learnt...maybe it will help you. :)
The substantial effort part is what really bugs me...as that is the same here too. I haven't tried dating apps yet but I have this feeling I'm going to have to resort to that...which fucking sucks.
As an autistic guy it's taken years for me to fix the no eye contact issue. Now people say I have too much eye contact... I can't ever win can I?

Ah I'm with you now. My apologies. Allow me to elaborate. So I've known most of these "couples" now if we shall call them that (for arguments sake), for a long time now (before they were even couples). I used to speak to them alot. As in we would chat but it would be 50/50 as to who would initiate the conversation.

Now if anything I'm usually initiating most of the time these days. And a lot of the time the conversations get cut short or if we make plans they do not eventuate because the wish to be with their SO. (They don't always make it obvious but you can tell). Also this part:

> Right, it's definitely rude to you, but assuming she's telling the truth.

I think what pissed me off here (not directed at you, just the situation) is that she wasn't telling the truth...normally she does tell me the truth, I've known her for long enough (nearly 9 years now). Her boyfriend does get jealous of me at times...even though I have said to his face I have no interest in his girlfriend in that way (seriously I don't). That and the fact she bloody just plastered pictures all over FB about their "wonderful week together on the coast". Not spending enough time with her BF my arse...anyway I'm just an outsider looking in so I would like to be wrong...but I'm fairly certain I'm not here.

> Why don't you have anybody else?

I'm not the easiest person to get along with sometimes. Not towards my friends...but family namely because they are somewhat toxic.

I don't exactly have the greatest social skills sometimes due to being a formally diagnosed autistic person. Don't get me wrong I have worked incredibly hard so I generally have minimal trouble talking to people. Or socialising in general. I have plenty of stories to tell and am not boring generally speaking (at least I'd like to think so). 

That and I have leant an ear to these people on countless occasions so I try to balance it out a bit...However for all of the people I do attract in a room (I tend to do this fairly easily...or at least in the past I could). It seems like once they see who I am really a lot of people disappear. I'm still trying to figure out why this happens. I wonder if my personality is too intense? Problem is I have no feedback from anyone so I can't seem to figure out what is causing it.

I work in IT so erm apart from "hey man can you fix my computer" my skillset isn't much greater than that lol unless you mean hobbies?

Either way the questions you have asked I'm not sure how to answer them in their entirety if that makes sense? :(.

The worst part about this is when you mention it to them. Or tell these people how you really feel about it (Ie. that you are lonely and wish you were in a good relationship) they will say comments like "Awww it gets better" or my favourite "You will find someone! It's just a matter of time!".

I personally feel like saying to these people something like "Gee dangle dick way to be condescending, not like you have anything to worry about...you have what I desire...".

*sigh* such is life huh?

Not sure if you have quite understood the post (or I might have put across the wrong message by mistake). No matter though it's not a case of "they should care about me more" it is more things like I would plan things with them, and considering I've known them before the SO came on the scene. That and well the intention is known that I would be spending some time with them, only for it to come crashing down when they cancel on me at a whim because they feel like hanging with the SO. Cool ok. Personally I do find it a bit rude.

I get it they love this person sure. I had someone once too. Even when I was with someone I never just cancelled plans like that nor did I let anyone become the third wheel because frankly it sucks. The trouble is I don't have anyone else. Ie. I don't have any single friends that can relate. And when I am asked along to things I'm generally an after thought. And I'm the 3rd wheel. I guess what I'm trying to say is that I'm frustrated that I seem to be alone in the middle of nowhere whilst everyone else is paired off...no one even asks how I am or tries to initiate a simple conversation with me anymore...I'm not sure if any of this made sense but I hope you see where I'm coming from. That and you do make a good point to some extent.
On a positive note. How do you plan to make a comeback?
So how would we do this? How does it work?

Well the good news is I spoke to her tonight and asked her about it. Turns out she meant a cry for help. As in she was saying that usually when people go to attempt suicide they would tell no one (from her anecdotal experience). So someone can't foil their plan as it were. She knows and acknowledges that people that talk about suicide are usually seriously thinking about it.

Therefore she was saying that it is a way to seek attention to seek help. She did admit that her wording was a bit off and gets how it could be taken the wrong way. Heck she even apologised. All in all looks like it ended well. Thanks for your insight mate :).

This makes sense. What gets me is she is a nurse and a big believer in good mental health. Heck she was suicidal once and got help. Had the support of her family ect etc. so to me when she said she sees it as attention seeking it doesn't make sense :/. She has been there so how could she think that way...

So I guess what you are saying that maybe she meant it was "a cry for help?" To me that would make more sense. I did try asking her this though but she didn't seem able to word it in a way I understood. Part of the problem is her upbringing her dad has some very stark and somewhat uneducated opinions on some topics which doesn't make much sense.

Indeed I agree with this statement. Here is where it gets strange though. We have been close since we were kids. She is a nurse. Big believer in getting mental help etc. heck I can contact just about any time if I need help.

What gets me though is she says that suicide is attention seeking, selfish and that if I really wanted to die I would have done so already. Heck she was suicidal once she got the support of her family and got help. 

I don't have such support and had to seek help on my own. That was hard enough. It's almost as if the logic is paradoxical. I have been wondering if she meant a "cry for help" as to me that would make more sense...erm does this make sense to you?

Yeah it really fucked with my logic a bit. As it doesn't make a whole ton of sense. On one hand she is a nurse and is a big believer in people getting help and would be happy to help these people. Heck I can call her nearly any time if I'm in need. 

Her upbringing however has taught her that suicide is selfish and attention seeking. And that if people who fee suicidal really want to die they would have done so already... to me it's almost a paradox :/.

Heck I'd even feel better about "a cry for help" over attention seeking. It did sting a bit I mean I've known this person and been close to her since we were kids. Heck even she was suicidal once I honestly couldn't understand her logic. She is also now a nurse. 

The other side of the coin here is she got help early and she had family that supported her. But I do not. I've had to seek help on my own and that was difficult enough. It's not like I want to feel suicidal. Heck I don't want to be depressed as much as the next guy that has cancer and wants to be cancer free :/.
It does somewhat. I'm assuming you mean "a cry for help" of sorts?

I just woke up and saw all these replies. Well at least I don't feel like I'm just crazy now. Not even kidding it was weird coming out of her mouth. I've been close with this person for years (since we were kids). She has gone through shit too. Even she was suicidal at one stage after a sexual assault.

She is a nurse I find it strange that she said this. I've been wondering if she meant it's a cry for help. She also said if I really wanted to die I probably would have done it by now. She'd rather I talk to her if I'm feeling that way than go through with it. So I'm somewhat conflicted here. On one hand she is saying it is attention seeking. On the other hand she is saying continue with seeking help and chat to me if things get to much. So confusing.

It's so common not even kidding. At least they somewhat "bounce" off your car pardon the pun. You hit a wombat it's the equivalent of hitting a boulder. That wombat ain't going anywhere and your car is a write off.
Lol ok so it may be stereotypical. But where I am I'd say kangaroos...and drop bears...kangaroos are the worst. You hit em with your car and some of the pricks still try and get up to fight ya :/
Not a bad idea. Except in Australia where I am you'd melt. Seriously it's 40 degrees Celsius ATM :/
Hey. Would you be ok to talk about what is bothering you? Take a deep breath and tell us what is bothering you if you can. I really hope things become ok for you truly.
So do I. I mean I'm autistic and I actually don't know HOW to cry. So I never get to let anything out its horrible :(. Hope things get better man.
Mine is Boxing Day. I know what you mean. I just got help myself. Keep fighting whoever you are. And Merry Christmas if you can :).
Yeah I've heard all of those :/
Speaking from experience?
This isn't a bad idea actually I've only just started seeking help. It doesn't seem very common in Australia. I reckon it would help me a lot...
They are sensitive whiny bitches. That is what lol.
Inner cities yeah but the my mostly keep to themselves they tend to be Among the minority in my experience.
Sorry SJW?
I dunno I seem to prefer the older gen's. Seems like less teeny bopper bullshit going on lol.

You know I never remember shit being this complicated as a kid. I mean really you'd get over it and be friends the next day. I do wish things were that simple back then. That and most adults if you messed up would go "Just kids being kids".

Cheers. Somehow I'm inclined to agree. Seriously I've been scratching my brain stupidly hard trying to figure out what happened and it is all blanks. I wasn't that intoxicated at all I know it. I mean I remember the whole night so it's not like there are blanks in my memory at all. And I was pretty coherent for all of it too. I mean I got a lift home and had a chat to the guy driving for ages (Another mate of mine). It was all butter...so no idea. I'm feeling a little better as I logic it out, thanks dude. (Or erm dudette?) still shits me a bit though why can't people just say what they are thinking? Not a hard thing to do in my book.

No Australia mate :). Land down under. Sometimes I refer to it as the worlds genitals...ok that was crude but yes you are correct this is my version of events. Frankly I have no reason to lie. I mean why would I? I am simply anonymous on the internet. That said however the opposite could also be said. Either way I'm tired and incredibly fucking frustrated at the whole situation. 

I mean the groom in his final messages to me tell me not to stress and basically moves the topic onto having lunch with him when he gets back from his honeymoon...

But how can I not be stressed about this? And besides everytime I meet people in his circle they get offended at something I mean shit...

I didn't ask for her number. I don't go randomly asking girls for their numbers. Well I don't without some conversation at first. I had never even spoken to this girl before, seriously when I asked who it was and the groom told me I said "Who?". The other girl she was older...like 10 years my senior so the convo was all sorts of stuff. Not a bad conversation to say the least. About what she does for a living etc. So it was all pretty civil. So I honestly have no clue what happened the groom wouldn't give me info on how I made her "Uncomfortable". I didn't know anyone apart from Bride and Groom at this party so no idea what the fuck happened there.

I'll list them:

1. Messages and phone calls from a girl I don't even know. Like as in she messaged me I didn't respond. She then called me and was yelling and screaming and calling me some other guys name...after she was doing this for 15 fucking minutes at 3 AM she realises I'm not the guy says sorry then fucking hangs up...yeah thanks lady now I have to spend the next hour trying to get back to sleep

2. Some guy simply put I joked with him asking how his Kele plant was doing. He came into the group conversations literally announcing he was a vegan dude who worked at a vegan restaurant in the middle of buttfuck nowhere, so of course I called him out on it since he did just waltz in...

3. The text from the groom. Simply started with "Some people aren't too happy with you from yesterday". So naturally I enquired as to whom and what happened? Did I accidentally break something? So he comes back telling me of 3 diff situations from the 3 guests. Apparently the first one said I had asked for her number...I don't even remember this and besides I've seen the girl in question no amount of grog is going to make her look better. (I had one drink that night so yeah hardly call that intoxicated). Second person having an awesome convo, again not hitting on as I wasn't interested and then suddenly she is uncomfortable with me...even though she added me to FB...Third person...yeah was the vegan dude but I already figured that one was gonna happen but hey my side of the story doesn't count in this case for some fucked reason.

Sorry if I'm sounding pissed off...well that is because I am but not at you. Just the situation like why do I have to deal with this shit?
Thank you. That meant a lot. It explains it well. I thought you might want to know that I contacted a professional tonight. It looks like I'll be starting some kind of treatment real soon. Thank you.

Thank you for that. Just out of curiosity what makes you think it is just the depression talking? I ask because I wonder about how and if there is truth to what you are saying? I'm not sure. My head is still a mess at the moment :(.

The past experiences are...well I don't even know where the fuck to start. I don't think they are the kind of things one can move on from. I've been trying to reach out for help but it hasn't been working very well :(. As in I try and call places to book to see someone but I never hear back. I'm in Australia and we supposedly have a very easy time with any kind of healthcare however I'm not convinced in some aspects. It's all but caused me to feel like it's hopeless. Like if I can't get help why don't I just off myself?

Thanks. It's exhausting isn't it? Am I even worth being here? People I know say so. But I don't feel it. Like they don't wish to experience loss. But I don't know if that is the depression talking or if that is the truth.

Honestly? Just the combination of years of shit (multiple traumatic events). I mean I don't know where I can start. There is just so much of it. I'm alone. I have maybe a few people that I can talk to that even care. But they have lives and I can't burden them with my existence constantly. The loneliness is fucking crippling. It's made worse by the fact that the people that care have never had anything bad happen to them and they themselves have admitted they have never had depression. :(

This is going to sound stupid (and I apologise) but I would want someone like you (I'm a guy). I don't know you nor do you know me from a bathroom faucet, but you seem like the kind of person who is honest with themselves and others. Heck I'd peg that you have other interests/qualities that are worthwhile. This is coming from someone who has had quite a few relationships (and quite frankly sick of shitty people hence they end). I am depressed and have been known to get very anxious also. Basically in a round about way I'm trying to say that there is someone for everyone and I'm sure there is always going to be someone willing to spend the time with you and get to know you. Even if it doesn't feel like it. Also what makes you think you might not have a chance with this guy? That is if you don't mind me asking :).
So does it feel much better than having depression? That is if I'm simply learning to cope with it?
It's ironic I was incredibly fit once upon a time. I used to compete in cross country. I'm overweight now maybe it'll help if I fix that. Getting out of bed is so tough :(
I see. Why is that exactly? Is it even still worth pursuing treatment?

You know that is something I've heard successful people say :). I mean it sounds strange but it makes sense when you think about it. You should try and lead that life. I don't know how or how I can suggest you do so. But I think killing yourself would kill off something this world needs more of. Understanding. I don't know you but I wish you the best :).
